bagPolicy.summary: The bag policy for Allas Live is not explicitly detailed on the provided page.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is no customer parking at Allas Pool. Visitors arriving by car should check the City of Helsinki website for nearby parking spaces, prices, and payment methods. Boaters can park at nearby marinas such as Katajanokka Helsinki Marina, Viroallas, or Linnanallas.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Allas Live's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Allas Restaurants offers a variety of dining experiences with Seagrill providing casual dining and a cocktail bar, Allas Cafe & Terrace serving breakfast, lunch, and coffee, and Sky Bar offering a unique meeting place with views. Special offerings include a porridge bar and self-service dining at Seagrill.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Allas Live, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Allas Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Allas Live. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Allas Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
